name: read_file
description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace (up to 200 KB), whole or just some lines: pass start_line and line_count to read only part of it (e.g. the lines around a grep match). Use this, never run_command (sed, cat, head), to read files. Returns the content and a version of the whole file; to change the file later with write_file or edit_file, pass that version.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace folder

start_line.description: First line to read (1 = the first line). Default: the whole file

line_count.description: How many lines to read from start_line (at most 2000)
